text: 下面进入小作文 06 · 告示 Notice：绿色校园“书香流转”旧书捐赠公益倡议答题骨架与变体精解。
第一段：阐明倡议活动崇高宗旨与活动主题。
To advocate environmental sustainability and support rural basic education, our university is launching a campus-wide book donation campaign.
动词不定式引导目的状语开篇：To advocate..., our university is launching...
launching a campus-wide book donation campaign
第二段：交代捐赠范围、规范要求与现场展位时间。
We warmly welcome unused books, particularly academic references, and collection stations will be set up at the Central Library this coming weekend.
清晰事务交代句式：Collection stations will be set up at [Location] from [Time].
Collection stations will be set up at the lobby of the Central Library.
第三段：感召全校师生践行善举，共筑书香温情。
Every donated book delivers a ray of hope to children in need; let us join hands to share our wisdom and foster social harmony!
公益号召金句：Let us join hands to share our wisdom and foster social harmony!
Let us join hands to share our wisdom and foster social harmony!
